sammendrag: This chapter describes the characteristics of young people who are not in employment, education or training (NEETs) in Norway. It identifies risk factors of NEET status, and presents evidence on the life satisfaction, and the attitudes of NEETs. It then presents an analysis of the dynamics of NEET status, looking at the incidence, duration and timing of NEET spells among young people, examining which young people are at risk of becoming long-term NEETs.
tittel: A profile of young people not in employment, education or training (NEET) in Norway
